description: Source kind profile architecture@1: the controlled identifiers admitted for Project Anatomy source_representation.source_kind. A kind names a family of sources, never a reader, a parser or a provider: declaring cad_drawing or email does not mean a qualified reader exists for it. A declared kind is governable, not true, admitted, Evidence or approved. An agency may add kinds through a local file kept outside the repository; that file is add-only and cannot change or remove a kind declared here.

rules: add-only: an id declared by this registry cannot be redeclared, changed or deprecated
an unreadable or invalid file makes the vocabulary unavailable instead of being ignored

entries.label: Revit
entries.description: Observation read from a Revit model by an admitted Revit adapter.

entries.label: IFC
entries.description: Observation read from an IFC model.

entries.label: Plan (PDF)
entries.description: A drawing sheet: plan, section, elevation or detail, read from a PDF or an image of a sheet.

entries.label: Relevé de plan
entries.description: Output of a drawing take-off (quantities and geometry measured on a drawing).

entries.label: Dessin CAO (DWG, DXF)
entries.description: A native CAD drawing. Naming this kind does not mean a qualified reader exists for it.

entries.label: Pièce écrite
entries.description: A written document: specification (CCTP), bill of quantities (DPGF), meeting minutes, report, letter, any text or office document.

entries.label: Courriel
entries.description: An e-mail message or one of its attachments taken as the source.

entries.label: Image
entries.description: A raster image that is not a photograph of the site.

entries.label: Photographie
entries.description: A photograph of the site or of a work.

entries.label: Saisie manuelle
entries.description: A professional description entered by a human.

entries.label: Numérisation
entries.description: A scan of a paper document or of a site.

entries.label: Autre
entries.description: A source that no other kind describes. Prefer a declared kind: add one through the agency file when a family of sources recurs.
